response.sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.recordvault AS order_reference,
    o.orderflow AS status,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    order_reference,
    status,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS share
  FROM counts
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    order_reference,
    status,
    record_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS share_minus_status_average
  FROM shares
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_minus_status_average DESC) AS difference_rank
  FROM compared
  WHERE share_minus_status_average > 0
)
SELECT
  order_reference,
  status,
  record_count,
  share,
  share_minus_status_average
FROM ranked
WHERE difference_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share_minus_status_average DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Shares are each order reference's fraction of risk/margin records among the matched orders with the same status; the average is the unweighted mean across order-reference/status combinations for that status. Ties at rank 10 are included.
